description: This file is the entry point for a React web application. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS stylesheet, and the main App component. It initializes the React application by creating a root DOM node and rendering the App component within a StrictMode wrapper.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root React DOM node for rendering the React application.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the root DOM node.
